name: Cubic Vertex-Transitive Partial Cubes Are Strictly Edge-Critical
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every cubic vertex-transitive partial cube is edge-critical, and the containment is strict.
proof: The complete cubic classification verifies edge-criticality family by family. The subdivision graph $S(K_4)$ is edge-critical but is neither cubic nor vertex-transitive.
